remarks: Welcome home to 811 Cleveland Drive, this is the ONE you've been WAITING for! Perfectly situated on an almost half acre lot with no neighbors to the left, all while being just 15 seconds off the NYS Thruway this home just screams convenience and location! The exterior of the home is Brick and Aluminum siding which just got a fresh coat of paint for extra low maintenance living. Step inside to brand new gleaming hard wood floors sprawling throughout the home, accompanied by recessed lighting and a stunning electric fireplace wall with new tile and charming original windows and shelving. A sunroom is attached for extra space to entertain or one of many options for a home office space! The Kitchen? A chefs dream, fit with a large amount of cabinets and counter space on  new beautiful quartz countertops and a stunning  gold kitchen sink. Each floor has a full bathroom for extra comfort as well, with the first floor and upstairs bathrooms are completely remodeled with new tile floor to ceiling, while the basement has a dated but still functional emergency bathroom! The first floor has  2 bedrooms one of them could be a great master suite which has a bonus room perfect for a walk in closet, home office, nursery, home gym, and more! Upstairs all 3 bedrooms are large and have large closets  all complete with matching hardwood floors. Some more of the updates include brand new HWT, Some new plumbing, over 20 new aluminum windows, concrete patio and sidewalks, retarred driveway, and partial fencing.  The Furnace, electric panels and roof were replaced by the previous owner and is said to be between  5-10 years old. The full dry basement offers more space and a bonus room for even more storage as well as a external door leading to the back patio. A large 2.5 car garage with large parking area is perfect for accommodating large gatherings or extend family's as well as a partially fenced in backyard behind the garage with a large fruiting Pear tree! All that's left to do is move right in and make it yours! Truly the perfect blend of modern updates with classic charm, dropped in the location you've been waiting for! Don't wait Showings start right away! Open House 9/6 1-3.
